name: chatgpt-local-dev-plugin
description: Private local-development MCP server for ChatGPT through OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/make-bin-executable.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run menu:check && npm run desktop:check
scripts.polish: npm run check && fallow audit && npm run polish:report
scripts.desktop:setup: npm ci --prefix desktop && npm exec --prefix desktop -- playwright install chromium webkit
